title: Yadda Google ke gano shafinku, da kayan aikin kyauta don duba shi

say: Yadda Google ke gano shafinku, da kayan aikin kyauta don duba shi.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module ɗaya daga cikin kwas ɗin SEO.
SEO yana tsaye don inganta injin bincike.
Yana nufin sauƙaƙe gidan yanar gizon don injunan bincike don ganowa, fahimta da nunawa ga mutanen da suka dace, ba tare da biyan kuɗin kowane dannawa ba.

say: Mataki na daya yana rarrafe. Google yana amfani da shirye-shirye na atomatik da ake kira crawlers. Google's crawler ana kiransa Googlebot.
Masu rarrafe suna samun sabbin shafuka musamman ta bin hanyoyin haɗin gwiwa, kuma daga taswirorin yanar gizo, waɗanda fayiloli ne waɗanda ke jera shafukan yanar gizo.

panel.heading: Matakai uku kowane shafi yana wucewa

Indexing: Google ya fahimta kuma yana adana shafin
Hidima: Google yana nuna matches mafi amfani

say: Mataki na biyu shine firikwensin. Google yana karanta rubutun, kanun labarai, hotuna da take, kuma yana iya adana shafin a cikin fihirisar sa, babban ma'ajin bayanai na shafuka.
Kwafi, shafuka masu sirara da shafuka tare da koyarwar noindex yawanci ana barin su.
